_comment: NUMBER FOREST, painted world. The ground is the painting in assets/backgrounds (drawn at 2x); collision comes from number_forest_collision.txt (generated by tools/build_world_map.py) plus the hand fixes below. Coordinates are tiles [x, y]; rects are [x, y, w, h]. 'trails' are walkable and drawn in-game (style 'path' or 'bridge'); 'encounters' are tall-grass zones ('paint': true draws extra grass where the painting has none).
name: Number Forest
_art: number_forest_tiles.png / _canopy.png are generated by tools/generate_world_art.py from this layout.

trails._note: forest trail: Whisper Fields up to Pine Ridge
planks: plateau to the lower desert

interactables.name: village sign
interactables.title: STARTER VILLAGE
text: Welcome to Starter Village, trainer! Wild MATHMON hide in the TALL GRASS of the Green Meadow, east along the path.
The red MATHMART sells items, the yellow house is the MONSTER SANCTUARY, and the blue MATHMON RECOVERY CENTER heals your team. The Evolution Shrine stands by the north path.

interactables.name: crossroads sign
interactables.title: CROSSROADS
text: West: Sunny Farms.  South-east: Woolly Pasture.
Past the pasture lie the ANCIENT NUMBER RUINS. Three Numera Seals guard the old stone arch.

interactables.name: bridge sign
interactables.title: STONE BRIDGE
text: The old stone bridge. Count its arches: 1 + 1 + 1... Rangers say the river remembers every sum.

interactables.name: Mirror Spring
interactables.title: MIRROR SPRING
text: Cool lake water bubbles between smooth stones. Your companion drinks and stretches.

interactables.name: rune tablet
interactables.title: THE UNKNOWN RUNES
text: Equations are carved into the stone. Each rune hides the value of x.

interactables.name: stone shrine
interactables.title: SEQUENCE STONES
text: Numbers are carved into a row of stones. One stone is blank. What comes next?

interactables.name: scale shrine
interactables.title: BALANCE SCALE
text: An ancient scale tips to one side. Find the missing weight to make it balance.

interactables.name: target shrine
interactables.title: TARGET NUMBER
text: Three number tiles and a glowing target. Combine the tiles to hit it exactly.

interactables.name: square shrine
interactables.title: MAGIC SQUARE
text: A 3x3 grid of stones. Every row, column and diagonal must add up to 15.

interactables.name: crystal portal
interactables.title: CRYSTAL PORTAL
locked_text: The crystal portal is dark. The Numera of Number Forest must be restored first (defeat the Arithmetic Beast).
text: The portal blazes with crystal light! Beyond it float islands of glass and starlight, where stronger MATHMON roam. Step through?

interactables.name: stone arch
interactables.title: THE STONE ARCH
interactables.sealed: Three Numera Seals bind the arch.
interactables.where: Find the Seal of Sums, the Seal of Products and the Seal of Parts in the Ancient Number Ruins.
interactables.open: The seals blaze with light and the arch groans open. Something huge stirs inside...
interactables.victory: THE ARITHMETIC BEAST is defeated! The Numera flows back into Number Forest. A cave opens in the ruins - the Algebra Cavern awaits!
interactables.quiet: The arch is quiet now. The Numera flows freely through Number Forest.

interactables.name: Mathmart
interactables.title: MATHMART
text: The Mathmart door slides open.

interactables.name: Monster Sanctuary
interactables.title: MONSTER SANCTUARY
text: Warm light spills out of the Sanctuary.

interactables.name: Evolution Shrine
interactables.title: EVOLUTION SHRINE
text: A tall crystal pillar. Monsters that are strong in battle AND in maths can evolve here.

interactables.name: numbered stone
interactables.title: NUMBERED STONE I
text: A smooth stone with a number carved into it.

interactables.name: numbered stone
interactables.title: NUMBERED STONE II
text: A smooth stone with a number carved into it.

interactables.name: numbered stone
interactables.title: NUMBERED STONE III
text: A smooth stone with a number carved into it.

interactables.name: Seal of Sums
interactables.title: SEAL OF SUMS
text: A cracked stone seal flickers between + and -.

interactables.name: Seal of Products
interactables.title: SEAL OF PRODUCTS
text: A cracked stone seal hums with rows and columns of light.

interactables.name: Seal of Parts
interactables.title: SEAL OF PARTS
text: A cracked crystal disc waits to be cut into fair parts.

interactables.name: Crystal Seal
interactables.title: THE CRYSTAL SEAL
text: An ancient crystal structure. Its facets show broken fractions.

interactables.name: cave entrance
interactables.title: ALGEBRA CAVERN
text: A cave has opened in the ruins. Crystal light glows deep inside. Go down into the Algebra Cavern?
locked_text: Rubble blocks a dark opening in the ruins. The Arithmetic Beast's power holds it shut.

interactables.name: Recovery Center
interactables.title: MATHMON RECOVERY CENTER
text: The Recovery Center doors whoosh open.

interactables.name: Professor's lab
interactables.title: NUMERIS LAB
text: The lab door creaks. It smells of old books and burnt toast.

npcs.name: Professor Numeris
greeting: Ah, a new trainer! I'm Professor Numeris. The NUMERA - the maths energy in every creature - is fading from Number Forest.
In battle, every move asks a maths question. Answer well and your monster strikes hard. Get stuck? Press H for a hint - mistakes are just data!
Win a battle in the Green Meadow grass, then head south-east to the Ancient Number Ruins. Three Numera Seals there must be restored.
lines: Press TAB for your trainer menu: party, bag, quests and your learning profile.
Weaken a wild monster, then throw a Basic Mathball from your BAG to capture it.
Crystal beats Time, Time beats Dark, Dark beats Earth, Earth beats Crystal!
Your monsters evolve at the shrine when they are strong in battle AND you are strong in their maths topic.

npcs.name: Rex
greeting: Hey, rookie! I'm Rex. My VOLTIX multiplies faster than you can blink. Think you can keep up?
Rematch? VOLTIX has been practising its times tables!
remarks: I'll capture CHRONOX before you do!

npcs.name: Tamsin

riddle.question: Riddle me this: I caught 6 fish each morning for 4 mornings. How many fish is that?
riddle.correct: Exactly! 6 groups of 4 make 24. Take this crystal - it helps the thinking glow.
riddle.wrong: Not quite. Think of 4 mornings, each with 6 fish. Come back and try again!

lines: The spring by the lake restores tired companions. Rest there whenever you need.
remarks: The fish are biting... in multiples of three.

lines: They say a cave opened in the ruins. Riddle me this: what is left over when the world is divided? ...I don't know either. Spooky!
A remainder is where the next count begins. I've been telling everyone. Nobody believes me. Do you?

not_started: Oh no, oh no! A VOLTIX startled me and I dropped my three numbered stones!
They only answer to the right arithmetic. Could you find them? One is in the Green Meadow, one on Sunny Farms, one in Woolly Pasture.
active: Have you found my stones? Green Meadow, Sunny Farms and Woolly Pasture - each answers to a sum.
completed: My stones are home again. Thank you, trainer!

not_started: The plank bridge to the Sunsand Desert has collapsed! I need help with the numbers to rebuild it.
active: Shall we work out the materials? Area for the planks, nails for each plank, and rails for both sides.
completed: The bridge is as good as new - the Sunsand Desert is open. Mind the GEOMAX out there!

npcs.name: Old Abacus
lines: History is a puzzle with missing pieces!
Sums is home! He shared his snack with me. Exactly half. Thanks!

barriers._note: THE BROKEN BRIDGE quest repairs this plank bridge to the Sunsand Desert.
barriers.blocked_text: The plank bridge has collapsed! Bram the builder (just west of here) needs help with the sums to fix it.

decor._note: the red house becomes the Mathmart
the blue house becomes the MCR
